# Children's Health Defense

> Children's Health Defense is a health advocacy organization focused on vaccine safety, medical freedom, and critiques of global health governance institutions.

The organization produces educational content through CHD-TV, a streaming platform featuring documentaries and advocacy programming on vaccine safety, pandemic policy, and health policy issues. Key figures include founders and researchers like Dr. Suzanne Humphries and Bernadette Pajer who investigate health topics ranging from vaccine adverse events to conditions like PANS/PANDAS.

## Key Topics

- Vaccine Safety
- Medical Freedom
- Health Advocacy
- CDC Criticism
- WHO Governance
- Pandemic Policy
- ACIP (Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices)
- Vaccine Adverse Events
- PANS/PANDAS
- Health Policy
- Documentary Content
- Biosecurity
- Global Health Governance
- Havana Syndrome
- Children's Health

## CHD-TV Streaming Platform

- [CHD-TV](https://live.childrenshealthdefense.org/chd-tv): CHD-TV streaming platform featuring health advocacy content and vaccine safety documentaries with shows like Good Morning CHD
- [Archived Shows](https://live.childrenshealthdefense.org/chd-tv/archive): Archive of past CHD-TV episodes covering WHO criticism, pandemic policy, and health governance topics
